description: Fixed-step stopping ablation for FGS (Task A). Re-runs the 40-step projected KS trajectory with a documented fresh retain-negative anchor (seed*1000+5) and scores attack/utility AUC at every iterate 0..40. Covers all GCN five-percent configs: 30 configs (3 datasets x 10 seeds).

attack.note: paired t-test of (KS-selected gap minus fixed-step gap); negative mean_diff on ATTACK = KS-selected iterate is closer to retrain than the fixed step
